sources.title: NOMAD UGV Debuts With Scout AI's 'Fastest' Autonomy System
sources.snippet: NOMAD is a next-gen UGV powered by Scout AI's fastest Fury autonomy system, with a 90 percent smaller, low-power stack enabling passive, camera-only autonomy for scouting, transport, and high-risk missions.

sources.title: NOMAD UGV Launches With Scout AI Autonomy System
sources.snippet: This milestone demonstrates Scout's focus on scaling its AI for diverse vehicle platforms. In this context, "fastest" refers not to the UGV's top speed but to the efficiency of its AI-driven autonomy. The system achieves lower latency, accelerated decision-making cycles, and enhanced real-time adaptability to dynamic environments.

sources.title: Scout AI - Foundation Model for Defense Robotics
sources.snippet: A vision‑language‑action (VLA) model is a multi‑modal large language model that takes real‑time camera data and a text prompt as inputs and outputs robot actions.

sources.title: NOMAD UGV Debuts With Scout AI's 'Fastest' Autonomy System
sources.snippet: Scout AI and Hendrick Motorsports Technical Solutions (HMS) have partnered on NOMAD, a next-gen unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) powered by the Fury autonomy system. The platform is the second UGV form factor to integrate Scout's autonomy stack and the first to run its "fastest foundation model yet." Here, "fastest" doesn't point to the vehicle's driving speed but to the autonomy ...

sources.title: Meet NOMAD: The UGV running Scout AI's "fastest" autonomy — camera‑only ...
sources.snippet: Bottom line NOMAD pairs HMS's rugged UGV engineering with Scout AI's Fury — a camera‑only, foundation‑model autonomy system trimmed to >90% smaller hardware and tuned for low‑latency decisions at the edge. The result is a low‑signature, payload‑flexible robot teammate aimed at scouting and load‑bearing in dangerous places.
